text:
Gunmen have killed a Chinese national, Wang Tingjian, and a Police Inspector, Yau Abba, during an ambush on a company vehicle conveying the expatriate in Alkaleri Local Government Area of Bauchi State.
Daily Trust gathered that the incident happened at Ruga Village in Gwana District, where the Chinese national was reportedly engaged in core drilling activities as part of a mining site survey on Saturday, November 14, 2026,
Police spokesperson in Bauchi, Nafiu Habib, confirmed the incident, saying the company vehicle conveying the expatriate was ambushed by suspected bandits while security personnel were escorting him.
Habib explained that the attack resulted in an exchange of gunfire between the security operatives and the assailants.
“Yes, it is true that the incident occurred on Saturday. The team was ambushed, and following an exchange of gunfire between the security personnel escorting the miner and the assailants, the miner and one police officer lost their lives,” he said.
Habib further disclosed that the incident took place in Gwana District while the mining team was in the area to conduct a survey at a mining site.
He said efforts were ongoing to track down and arrest those responsible for the attack, while security agencies were working to establish the circumstances surrounding the incident.
